QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Caretaker's Duties
QuestInfo.0:
You've got your own cozy,spacious house, and even a caretaker to help you keep it in order. Things are really looking up! You shoulg pick up some furniture to decorate your home, and invite some friends over to hang out.


#b#e[Tip: Caretaker Services]#n
1. You can review your the caretaker's details by pressing the #i3801395# button from the Home menu.
2. You can receive a buff from your caretake once a day. Your caretaker's stats and their Closeness to you will affect the buff's effects.
3. You can send your caretaker on shopping trips to pick up furnishings for you. The type of furnishing you can obtain and the duration of the shopping trip will vary depending on which shopping pack you select.
4. You can switch caretakers from the Settings window.
